findings.rationale: The materialization name is derived only from the source stem and PID, then opened with std::fs::write, which truncates an existing path and follows symlinks. A stale/PID-colliding entry or precreated symlink can therefore be overwritten, and Drop later unlinks the shared name. Create the file atomically with create_new and an unguessable unique suffix.

For Markdown input, verify receives both the temporary physical path and the original display path, but scenarios receives only the temporary path. Parse/model/trace failures and the fallback verification path can consequently expose the PID-derived file identity, which is deleted when the guard drops, instead of the user-supplied Markdown path.
